sphere_about_origin.rule_definition: max over the eight AABB corners of ||corner||_2 = || |center_offset_m| + half_extents_m ||_2 about the robot reference origin
proof_notes: the farthest point of an axis-aligned box from the origin is the corner whose coordinate signs match the box center offset, so the max corner distance is || |center_offset_m| + half_extents_m ||_2
a rigid rotation about the reference origin preserves every corner distance to the origin, so the sphere centered at the origin contains the box for any such rotation
the sphere center is the robot reference origin, not the AABB center; the half diagonal about the AABB center is not an around-origin radius when the center offset is non-zero

sphere_about_aabb_center.rule_definition: radius_m = || half_extents_m ||_2 with the sphere centered at the AABB center
proof_notes: the distance from the AABB center to any corner is the half diagonal, and rotation about the center preserves it
limitations: valid only with the sphere centered at the AABB center; not an around-origin radius
